newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand PTT buys Aug fuel oil at $8.50/T premium.
newsitem.headline: Thailand PTT buys Aug fuel oil at $8.50/T premium.

text.p: State-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) has awarded its tender to buy fuel oil for August delivery at $8.50 per tonne over Singapore spot quotes, cost and freight to Sri Racha, industry sources said on Wednesday.

The tender which sought the combination cargo of 75,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke grade, 2.0 percent sulphur and 5,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke, 1.0 percent fuel oil, closed July 1 and was valid until July 2.
The cargo is for delivery August 15-25.
PTT had issued the spot tender because the term contracts volumes were not sufficient to meet its demand, sources said earlier.
